summary: Sandbach United fielded an unchanged side against New Mills at Hind Heath Road, looking to secure back-to-back home wins following their narrow victory over Stafford Town on Saturday. The match remained tightly contested through the opening stages, with both sides creating chances but neither able to break the deadlock in the first 15 minutes. The Bach will be keen to maintain their positive run of form in what promised to be a tough test under hot, dry conditions.
